name: starter-p2-team-otr-dedicated-annual
about: Starter P2 "The number" on the opening-team-otr-dedicated-annual brief (the owner's copy rating, 2026-11-12).

brief.subject: Class A team drivers, dedicated OTR

subject_matter.in_our_words: Teams stay together; we do not split a good pair.

recipe.name: The number
recipe.hook_formula: Lead with the pay figure alone, exactly as the brief states it and with its unit (per mile, per week, per year). If the brief states no pay, lead with its strongest other figure (a bonus, home days, miles) — never a figure the brief does not hold. Who the job is for (the licence, the kind of run) goes in a few words on the small line above it, never in the pay line.
recipe.image_prompt_template: A plain {surface} background, {texture}, {light}, a soft {tone} gradient, nothing in the frame, no text, no logos, no lettering

en.primary_text: Silvicom Inc runs dedicated, coast-to-coast dry van lanes with drop-and-hook freight. Teams earn $95,000 to $110,000 per year. Refer a driver, earn a $1,500 bonus. Late-model equipment. Must be 23+ with 2 years of experience.
en.headline: Dedicated OTR team pay
